instructions:
1. Lie on your back and place both feet on a surface about 30 cm high, one foot flat and the other staggered so only the heel rests on top.
2. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands.
3. Press through the lead heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and pause briefly.
5. Lower your hips under control to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the heel of the working leg, not the toes.
2. Keep the staggered foot light to bias load onto the lead glute.
3. Pad the dumbbell with a towel for comfort.
4. Keep your core braced to prevent the lower back from arching.
name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left knee in a figure-four position.
3. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands.
4. Press through the heel of the supporting foot and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knee.
5. Lower your hips under control to the start.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Keep the figure-four leg relaxed throughout.
2. Press through the heel to bias the glute.
3. Squeeze the working glute at the top.
4. Brace your core to keep the pelvis level and stop rotation.
name: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions:
1. Sit with your upper back against a bench and place a dumbbell across your hips.
2. Bend your knees with feet flat, then cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-four position.
3. Press through the grounded heel and drive your hips up until your torso is parallel to the floor.
4. Squeeze your glutes and hold briefly at the top.
5. Lower your hips under control until they nearly touch the floor.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Set the bench edge at mid-back height for support.
2. Hold the dumbbell firmly and pad it with a towel.
3. Keep your chin tucked and ribs down to avoid arching.
4. Drive through the heel for maximum glute engagement.
name: Dumbbell Figure Four Hip Thrust

instructions:
1. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out, holding a dumbbell in each hand between your legs.
2. Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
3. Drive through your heels and explosively jump straight up, extending hips, knees, and ankles.
4. Land softly back into the squat with knees tracking over your toes.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Generate explosive power from the legs and hips.
2. Land with soft, bent knees to absorb impact.
3. Keep your core braced and chest up throughout.
4. Use a light dumbbell to maintain jump quality.
name: Dumbbell Frog Jumps

instructions:
1. Stand holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, elbows down.
2. Step forward with one leg and bend both knees to descend.
3. Lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee is just above it.
4. Push through your front heel to return to standing.
5. Repeat, alternating legs.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your foot.
2. Hold the dumbbell tight to your chest to stay upright.
3. Brace your core for balance and anti-rotation control.
4. Take a long enough step to load the glute, not just the knee.
name: Dumbbell Goblet Forward Lunge
